title: Gate and identity source disagree: render-level callers can store records without from
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py:251-252. _request_is_oscore_or_admin accepts request-level bound identity while rebind requires remote.hostinfo; SimpleNamespace(remote=None, oscore_context_id=b'x') passes gate storing sender-less records. Unreachable through LichenTransport (server remote always populated); affects direct render API consumers/test drivers. Reject with 4.01/BAD_REQUEST or deterministic fallback binding.
close_reason: Gate/binding agreement: new _request_remote_hostinfo() helper; _request_is_oscore_or_admin rejects any request without non-empty remote.hostinfo string BEFORE granting via OSCORE identity or local-admin, eliminating sender-less record creation (SimpleNamespace(remote=...no hostinfo)+oscore_context_id or remote=None -> 4.01). MessagesResource.render_post now binds body['from'] unconditionally post-gate (gate guarantees str), dropping the old hasattr divergent branch; MessageReceiptsResource shares the stricter gate harmlessly. Production unaffected: LichenRemote always exposes hostinfo; all existing OSCORE-positive tests already bind hostinfo remotes. Regression tests TestGateRequiresRemoteIdentity: request-level b'oscore-peer-id' with empty SimpleNamespace remote and with remote=None -> UNAUTHORIZED with zero inbox/_sent/_next_id mutation; receipts variant. Full tests/coap suite 1679 passed, ruff clean.
